bioconda.name: flexserv
bioconda.summary: FlexServ protein structure conformational ensemble generation tools
bioconda.description: Tools for the generation of protein structure conformational ensembles taken from the FlexServ MMB Web Server (https://mmb.irbbarcelona.org/FlexServ/): Discrete Molecular Dynamics (DMD), Brownian Dynamics (BD) and Normal Mode Analysis (NMA).
